name: Tobias Börner
also: Geschäftsführer, Civitas Europe · CMO, Orcrist Technologies
bio: Founded Innoshare in 2012. Co-founded LOVOO and ran its marketing through two exits, co-founded Fastic. Today Geschäftsführer of Civitas Europe and CMO of Orcrist Technologies.

name: Tim Börner
bio: Runs Innoshare from Singapore, leading advisory mandates, operations and company-building work across Europe and Asia-Pacific.
